tools.name: arxiv_search
tools.description: Searches the arXiv API by topic and returns paper titles, authors, abstracts, and PDF links. No API key required.

query.description: Research topic or search query (e.g. graph neural networks, quantum computing)

max_results.description: Maximum number of papers to return (1-25, default 5)

tools.name: crypto_price_checker
tools.description: Fetches live cryptocurrency market prices, 24h change, and market cap in USD using the free CoinGecko API.

coin_id.description: Cryptocurrency ID (e.g. bitcoin, ethereum, solana, dogecoin)

tools.name: currency_converter
tools.description: Converts amounts between fiat currencies using free ECB exchange rates from the Frankfurter API (api.frankfurter.dev). No API key required.

from_currency.description: ISO 4217 source currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP)

to_currency.description: ISO 4217 target currency code (e.g. INR, JPY, CAD)

tools.name: duckduckgo_search
tools.description: Searches the web via DuckDuckGo and returns top search results including titles, snippets, and URLs.

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return (default 5)

tools.name: jwt_decoder
tools.description: Decodes JSON Web Tokens (JWT) and Base64Url strings to inspect header, payload claims, and expiration status without requiring private keys.

token.description: The JWT token string or base64url encoded string to decode

tools.name: langchain_wrapper_demo
tools.description: A demo tool configuration used for verifying external LangChain framework tool wrapper integration examples.
tools.author: govardhanreddyg2005-byte

query.description: The search query or input string to process

count.description: The number of results to return

tools.name: open_meteo_weather
tools.description: Fetches current weather and a 7-day forecast for any city using the free, zero-auth Open-Meteo API.

city.description: City or place name to look up (e.g. London, Tokyo, New York)

forecast_days.description: Number of forecast days to return (1-16, default 7)

tools.name: rss_feed_reader
tools.description: Parses any RSS or Atom feed URL and returns the latest articles with titles, links, summaries, and publish dates. No API key required.

feed_url.description: Full HTTP or HTTPS URL of the RSS or Atom feed

max_results.description: Maximum number of articles to return (1-25, default 5)

tools.name: slack_notifier
tools.description: Sends rich markdown notifications and webhook alerts directly to Slack channels.

webhook_url.description: Slack Incoming Webhook URL (or reads SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL env var)

tools.name: sqlite_query_runner
tools.description: Execute parameterized SQL queries, inspect table schemas, and fetch structured tabular results from SQLite databases safely with configurable read-only safeguards.

database_path.description: Path to the SQLite database file (.db, .sqlite, .sqlite3)

query.description: SQL query to execute (e.g. SELECT, PRAGMA table_info, EXPLAIN)

params.description: Optional list or tuple of positional parameters for parameterized SQL execution

read_only.description: Enforce read-only mode to prevent write/destructive operations (default: true)

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows to return (default: 100)

returns.description: Query execution result containing columns, rows as key-value objects, row_count, execution_time_ms, and status

tools.name: wikipedia_search
tools.description: Searches Wikipedia and returns clean extract summaries, page titles, and canonical URLs for agent knowledge retrieval.

query.description: Topic or title to search on Wikipedia

sentences.description: Number of summary sentences to return (default 3)

tools.name: hackernews_profile
tools.description: Fetches HackerNews user profiles with karma, creation date, and submission count. Also retrieves top stories with scores and comment counts.
